question: Identify the synonym of 'Jeopardy':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Risk**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Jeopardy"** means danger or risk; a situation in which someone or something is exposed to harm or loss. (खतरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The hikers put their lives in jeopardy by climbing during the storm.
 
 
• **"Risk"** refers to the possibility of harm, injury, or loss. It is a synonym of jeopardy and aligns perfectly with the meaning. (जोखिम)
 
 
• **Example:** Investing in the stock market comes with significant risk.
